title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inherited from the previous page. E is an elliptic curve over a base S with 2 invertible. σ is the involution x ↦ a − x. X = E/σ is a P^1-fibration over S. The group scheme V = ₂E acts on X by translation. I is the fixed-point scheme of σ, i.e. the solutions of 2x = a. It is a torsor under M_0 = ₂E and has degree 4. The previous page found that the points of E with nontrivial stabilizer in V are those with 4x = 2a but 2x ≠ a.

This page identifies these points. The solutions of 4x = 2a form a torsor under M = ₄E_0. That torsor is the contracted product I ∧^{M_0} M along the inclusion M_0 ≅ 2M ⊂ M, and has degree 16. Removing I (degree 4) leaves a scheme of degree 12. Dividing by {1,σ} (a quotient of degree 2) gives 6 points in X. This is formula (27): Δ = (I ∧^{M_0} M ∖ I)/{1,σ}.

(28) records the structure. M ≅ ₄E_0 is locally isomorphic to (Z/4Z)^2_S. M_0 ≅ M ⊗ Z/2 ≅ 2M ≅ ₂E_0 = V.

In the split case E = E_0, the 12 points of exact order 4, grouped into 6 pairs {x, −x}, give the octahedral configuration Δ in X ≅ P^1. Concretely, each of the three nontrivial elements of the Klein four-group V acting on P^1 has 2 fixed points, giving the 6 vertices of an octahedron.

(29) is a commutative square.
- Top: I ⊂ E → E_0 ≅ E/M_0 is an étale isogeny, multiplication by 2 in the split case.
- Left: E → X = E/σ is ramified over the points of I.
- Right: E_0 → Σ_J = E_0/{±1} is ramified over D_J ∪ t(S). These are the three nonzero 2-torsion points together with the origin section.
- Bottom: X → Σ_J = X/V, with J = V*, is ramified over D_J. D_J is the 3-point image of Δ, the octahedral vertices modulo the Klein group.
- The square is cartesian over Σ_J* = Σ_J ∖ D_J.

Purpose: to show that the pair (E,σ), equivalently (E_0, I), is encoded by E_0 → Σ_J together with a V-cover X → Σ_J. The next page concludes that I is 'de la poudre aux yeux': one may reduce to the case I = ₂E_0, the trivial torsor. All of this serves a description of level-2/level-4 moduli of elliptic curves in characteristic ≠ 2.
errors: The previous page called Δ the 'configuration icosaèdrale'. This page correctly says octahedral: 6 points, the fixed points of the Klein four-group on P^1. The earlier word is a slip, silently corrected here.
The label 'degré 2' under the outer brace of (27) refers to the degree of the quotient by {1,σ}. Δ itself has degree 6 (12/2), not 2. This is notational ambiguity rather than an error.
The square (29) is not cartesian over the points of D_J: E_0/Σ_J is ramified there while E/X is not. The next page notes this correctly.

ideas.what: Locus of nontrivial V-stabilizers on E/σ described as a torsor contracted product modulo σ.
ideas.modern_name: Torsor contracted product / pushout of torsors along 2M ⊂ M
ideas.where_published: Contracted products of torsors are standard Grothendieck-school language (SGA, Giraud)

ideas.what: The 4-torsion points of E modulo ±1 give the octahedral configuration in P^1 under the Klein four-group action.
ideas.modern_name: Octahedral/Klein configuration; 4-torsion and Kummer line, related to X(4)

ideas.what: Commutative square of the isogeny E → E_0, the Kummer quotients, and the Klein-group quotient X → Σ_J, cartesian off the branch locus.
ideas.modern_name: Kummer line of an elliptic curve; isogeny compatible with quotients

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine, careful working-out over a general base of the classical picture: 4-torsion on the Kummer line and the octahedron under the Klein four-group. It is correct, apart from a slip on the previous page that is corrected here. Nothing appears new.
transcription_corrections: 'puisque contexte' and 'qui est contexte au dessus de Σ_J^*' should almost certainly read 'cartésien' ('puisque cartésien', 'qui est cartésien au dessus de Σ_J^*').
The first line probably reads 'x pt en I ∧^{₂E_0}(₄E_0) ∖ I'. The '9' above is likely a stray mark or 'g', not an index.
'en groupes par 6/paires' means 'groupés par paires (6 paires)': the 6 above the slash counts the pairs.
The right vertical arrow label reads 'ramifié au dessus des pts de D_J ∪ t(S)'. The left label reads 'ramifié au dessus des pts de I'.
